arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test multi-field parsing with newlines
tests = [
    ('{} {}', 'hello world'),
    ('{} {}\n', 'hello world\n'),
    ('{}\n{}', 'hello\nworld'),
    ('{:d}\n{:d}', '42\n100'),
]

for fmt, text in tests:
    result = parse.parse(fmt, text)
    print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {text!r}) = {result}')
"
